title: How large must the container be?
hook: Search for a workable limit while the loads stay in order.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Binary-search a monotone feasibility predicate using greedy contiguous packing.

misconception: Trying every capacity is necessary because the answer is not in the input.
objective: Binary-search a monotone feasibility predicate using greedy contiguous packing.

claims.text: Greedy packing supplies a feasibility test for a proposed capacity. Increasing capacity cannot require more containers, so binary search operates on the answer space rather than on the load positions.
